# Decapod Labs

> Decapod Labs builds infrastructure for autonomous engineering. Decapod is a local-first governance kernel existing coding agents call for durable project knowledge, ownership, authority checks, and delivery.

A person delegates an outcome in ordinary language. The agent resolves relevant knowledge and constraints, coordinates changes, recovers from ordinary failures, and delivers under existing authority. Decapod runs on demand and preserves the decisions, work state, and evidence that subsequent sessions need. Decapod Local is free and works without signup. Decapod Cloud provides an optional shared service for teams. Current commands and their contracts are available from the installed binary through `decapod docs ingest`.

This index covers public product information and documentation. Authenticated account, organization, billing, and repository data are outside its scope. The linked pages are the current sources for product details and limitations.

## Start here

- [Decapod Labs](https://decapodlabs.ai/): Product overview, capabilities, and examples of governed agent work.
- [Documentation](https://decapodlabs.ai/decapod/): Public Decapod documentation and chapter index.
- [Documentation agent index](https://decapodlabs.ai/decapod/llms.txt): Full chapter-level Markdown navigation index generated from the Decapod mdBook.
- [Quickstart](https://decapodlabs.ai/decapod/quickstart.html): Install Decapod and initialize a repository.
- [Mental model](https://decapodlabs.ai/decapod/mental-model.html): The relationship between agents, repository state, and governance.
- [Agent-first architecture](https://decapodlabs.ai/decapod/concepts/agent-first.html): How coding agents invoke the kernel.
- [CLI reference](https://decapodlabs.ai/decapod/reference/cli.html): Public command reference; consult the installed binary for version-matched contracts.
- [Errors and recovery](https://decapodlabs.ai/decapod/reference/errors.html): Interpret failures and supported recovery paths.

## Research and applications

- [Features & capabilities](https://decapodlabs.ai/#features) explains how intent, the Constitution, living specs, context, durable memory, and work ownership fit together.
- [Applied work](https://decapodlabs.ai/#showcase) showcases Clack for macOS and concurrent multi-agent engineering swarms governed by Decapod.
- [Accountable Agentic Execution](https://github.com/DecapodLabs/accountable-agentic-execution) is a public technical report and reproducible evaluation harness in pre-results status.
- [Writing & announcements](https://decapodlabs.ai/writing/): Published essays, architectural writings, and release dispatches from Decapod Labs.

## Evaluation and boundaries

- [Proof concepts](https://decapodlabs.ai/decapod/concepts/proof.html): Evidence and validation boundaries.
- [Versioned agent-host results](https://github.com/DecapodLabs/decapod/blob/a2d7266db2c63fea15f86c2de75a84f2cb55e8f3/docs/research/host-outcome-pilot/sec12-host-activation-2026-11-26.md) records executed host trials and partial outcomes. [Cloud acceptance](https://github.com/DecapodLabs/decapod/issues/1809) tracks hosted qualification.
- [Recorded engineering case study](https://decapodlabs.ai/proof.html): An observed failure, repair, validation, and publication, with evidence and explicit limits.
- [Trust and privacy](https://decapodlabs.ai/trust/): Public network, privacy, credential, and service boundaries.
